_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values. config.json is gitignored and never committed.
_Site: Which WarcraftLogs site to query: 'fresh', 'classic', or 'retail'.
_ServerSlug: Your realm in WCL's slug form, lowercase and hyphenated (e.g. 'spineshatter').
_SavedVariablesPath: Full path to the addon's SavedVariables file. Replace <AccountName> with the folder name under WTF\Account.
